column2: a small figure at an open cottage door, on the doorstep a large black raven with a sealed envelope at its feet, the figure looking down at it
a hand reaching for a letter pushed under a door, light under the door, a shadow of a bird on the other side
an old hand-drawn treasure map of an imaginary island, torn in half with a ragged edge, a tiny figure stepping off the torn edge into empty paper
a sheet of paper with a large ragged hole torn through the middle, a tiny figure standing on the edge of the hole looking down into the blank
